entries.owner: RTS ECS world and registered RTS services
entries.reason: RTS cross-domain links distinguish ECS generation handles from service keys and rebuild after restore.
evidence: docs/dev/领域短根继承与跨域组合架构.md
entries.create: EntityLink::bind and ServiceLink::bind return checked links.
entries.ownership: The ECS world or capability registry owns the target; a link never claims target ownership.
entries.destroy_order: Target destruction invalidates generation links; service unregister invalidates key links.
entries.restore: Entity links rebuild from entity identity and service links rebind by stable logical key.
entries.stale: Entity generation and service presence are checked before use.

entries.reason: RTS systems publish machine-readable access contracts before view iteration and deferred structural changes.
entries.entity_scope: live Unit, Building, ResourceNode, Faction and Match ECS roots in the current world
entries.view: typed generation-checked RTS views; each view closes before deferred creation, destruction or relationship repair
entries.read_set: identity, faction links, motion, orders, production, effects, research definitions, match rules and economy queries as applicable; movement-group pacing reads Navigation trafficWaiting, Supply convoyWaiting and Morale/Tactics retreat-cover state
entries.write_set: motion, orders, lifecycle projections, production queues, faction research state, match participant/state/event components and affected surrender roots; RTS-owned movement-group membership and rebuilt Navigation formation speed projection
entries.structural_changes: unit production and surrender collect stable handles during traversal, then create or destroy only after the relevant view closes
entries.events: ordered command, production, effect, technology unlock, surrender and victory lifecycle facts are emitted after authoritative mutation
entries.services: injected SimulationStep, definition registry, action executor, resource query and capability services; callbacks are synchronous and not retained
entries.phase: owner-thread deterministic simulation after command ingestion and before presentation; match evaluation follows authoritative economy settlement

entries.reason: Formation orientation and layout are canonical replay inputs and must survive round trips.
entries.schema: EVERTS_COMMANDS positional text schema with explicit version header.
entries.version: Versions 1 through 5; v4 stores orientation/new layouts, v5 adds MovementGroup operation and groupLeadDistance.
entries.migration: Import v1-v3 with zero rotation and legacy enum bounds; v1-v4 cannot encode MovementGroup. Export legacy inputs at their original version; group commands select v5.
entries.unknown_fields: Reject unsupported header versions, malformed fields and unknown enums; positional trailing data must parse as a complete valid record.
entries.restore_atomicity: Parse records into a local candidate vector and validate through the canonical queue before replacing or appending target history.

entries.reason: Movement-group members bind stable unit identities to exact order lifetimes and must survive restore.
entries.schema: RTSStateSnapshot typed in-memory schema; canonicalStateJson is its synchronization projection.
entries.version: Version 2 adds stable movement-group membership and leadDistance.
entries.migration: Version 1 accepts no movement groups; both v1 and v2 rebuild generation-checked member handles. Derived pacing factors reset and rebuild on the next step.
entries.unknown_fields: Typed snapshots cannot represent unknown fields; unknown versions and invalid, duplicate or order-mismatched members are rejected.
entries.restore_atomicity: Stage member references and order validation before root mutation, then publish groups with the validated restored roots.

entries.reason: The movement-group boundary owns order-bound membership and publishes derived pacing and moving slots into existing motion backends. Radius-clear grid segments permit direct formation travel; constrained routes retain per-unit steering and release pacing until clearance recovers.
evidence: docs/dev/群体行为与流场模块设计.md
protocol: EVERTS_COMMANDS v5 MovementGroup input; RTSStateSnapshot v2 stable group membership
entries.thread_affinity: RTS simulation owner thread; non-reentrant admission/restore/step, no callbacks and no retained raw pointers.

trim.evidence: Minimal excludes RTS by default. Custom minimal+rts+crowd composition tests exercise both injected Crowd and native motion; this is runtime provider-presence evidence, not independent RTS L2 link trimming.

cost_notes.why: Caller constructs one owning member batch; existing quadratic fan-out is amortized per group command.
